contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 12
validation_requirements: Focused WorkspaceSwitcher, Topbar and Sidebar interaction and presentation tests
Real-composition cross-workspace integration test covering actual SOC Dashboard and Executive Overview through / to /executive to / with matching Sidebars and current-workspace labels
Focused PlatformLayout and ExecutiveLayout contract tests with explicit 1536px fit arithmetic and controlled smaller-viewport scrollWidth greater than clientWidth and Main reachability evidence
Existing WorkspaceOutlet route and history regressions without changing its production implementation
Focused Rework 10 SOC Dashboard geometry, truthful Trend, drill-down and UTF-8 regressions
Full frontend regression in regular parallel mode
Scope Guard proving changes are limited to the exact 25 allowed paths and every prohibited path remains unchanged
Direct Architect inspection of switcher discoverability, real workspace composition, fit and overflow arithmetic, Rework 11 A and Rework 10 preservation
Product Owner live acceptance at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom exercising SOC Dashboard to Executive Overview and back plus scroll and overflow behavior
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 12 is executable. It is limited to the three remaining Rework 11 Architect-review blockers; the accepted Executive inset implementation is frozen except for a narrowly necessary test seam and all Rework 10 preservation requirements remain binding.
Keep the canonical WorkspaceSwitcher to setWorkspace to navigate mechanism and introduce no second workspace authority or routing path.

The WorkspaceSwitcher visibly presents the exact current SOC Analyst or Executive identity and is clearly recognizable as an interactive workspace-selection control through a bounded control surface, legible typography, visible affordance and focus or interaction styling.
The current 9px muted transparent borderless unpadded switcher presentation is not acceptable; do not restore a generic Enterprise Workspace identity or redesign the broader Topbar.
Preserve the existing accessible menu name, keyboard semantics, enabled-workspace filtering, canonical destinations and Rework 10 SOC visual contract.

A deterministic real-composition integration regression exercises SOC Analyst Dashboard to WorkspaceSwitcher to Executive to Executive Overview to WorkspaceSwitcher to SOC Analyst to SOC Dashboard using / to /executive to /.

For that integration regression SOCWorkspace and ExecutiveWorkspace are not replaced with generic workspace-level text doubles; their real production composition renders and identifiable real SOC Dashboard and Executive Overview content is asserted.
The integration regression verifies matching real Sidebar, current workspace identity and pathname after each switch without Browser Back, reload or manual URL entry.

Only lower-level network or API dependencies may be deterministically isolated at their existing client or repository boundaries; workspace, page, layout, router and navigation composition remain real and no synthetic security data is introduced.
Existing URL-authoritative Back and Forward regressions remain passing and frontend/src/platform/workspace/WorkspaceOutlet.tsx remains byte-identical.
Retain the accepted platform contract: 1536px viewport width, 164px Sidebar track, 1372px post-Sidebar column, viewport-bound root, min-width 0, min-height 0 and Main-owned overflow on both axes.

Deterministic layout arithmetic proves the Executive border-box width does not exceed the 1536 minus 164 equals 1372px Main client width and its 24px inset remains internal through border-box sizing without horizontal overflow, clipping or inaccessible content.

A smaller deterministic viewport fixture uses authorized test content with declared minimum width greater than Main client width, proves scrollWidth greater than clientWidth, assigns overflow ownership to Main and proves the complete horizontal extent is reachable through Main rather than document or body.

Because jsdom does not perform browser layout, style or source assertions alone are not described as pixel measurement. Explicit reusable test-only viewport, Sidebar, inset and content-width arithmetic plus controlled DOM dimension properties or an already configured browser mechanism must reject incorrect Sidebar subtraction, external inset addition, missing overflow and document-owned scrolling.

Do not force a scrollbar or introduce production width hacks to satisfy tests; preserve the accepted Executive 24px inset and PlatformLayout implementation unless a demonstrated defect requires the smallest correction.
Rework 11 A remains passing: 24px Executive inset, 164px Sidebar track, no negative margins or transforms and no Sidebar overlap regression.

Every Rework 10 result remains passing: SOC visual contract, Exposed Assets 230px, no-overlap arithmetic, truthful neutral Trend, Gauge, Donut, status visualization, lower 632:722 split, four SOC drill-downs, UTF-8, truthful states, no fake data, no backend changes and no provider calls.
Scope Guard permits only the exact 25 allowed paths and every prohibited path remains unchanged.
The immutable reference remains .ai/references/TASK-0122-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.

Architect review must directly confirm visible switcher discoverability, prominent current identity, real SOC and Executive composition, complete SOC to Executive to SOC coverage, credible 1536px fit and smaller-viewport overflow ownership evidence, truthful jsdom limitations, Rework 11 A preservation and complete Rework 10 preservation.
Product Owner live acceptance at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom remains mandatory and must exercise SOC Dashboard to Executive Overview and back plus scroll and overflow behavior.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
